relationships.subject: spared nerve injury
relationships.evidence_quote: we found that spared (sciatic) nerve injury (SNI) increased Piezo1 protein levels in inhibitory parvalbumin (PV)-expressing interneurons (PV-INs) but not in glutaminergic CaMKⅡ<sup>+</sup> neurons, in the bilateral ACC

relationships.subject: spared nerve injury
relationships.evidence_quote: there was a reduction in the number of PV-INs but not in the number of CaMKⅡ positive neurons in the bilateral ACC in the SNI group 7 d after surgery compared with the sham group

relationships.subject: TNF-alpha
relationships.evidence_quote: increased levels of Piezo1 and NLRP3 were also observed in the rrTNF-stimulated primary culture of ACC neurons

relationships.subject: TNF-alpha
relationships.evidence_quote: The administration of recombinant rat TNF-α (rrTNF) at a dose of 5 ng/mL into BV2 microglial cells elevated the protein levels of Piezo1 and NLRP3

relationships.subject: MCC950
relationships.evidence_quote: Pretreatment of BV2 cells with the NLRP3 inhibitor MCC950 (10 nM) for 1 h blocked the rrTNF (5 ng/mL)-mediated induction of caspase-1 and IL-1β

relationships.subject: NLRP3
relationships.evidence_quote: Blocking the activation of NLRP3 inflammasome using MCC950 (10 mg/kg i.p., once a day) reversed the SNI-induced overexpression of Piezo1 in the bilateral ACC

relationships.subject: MCC950
relationships.evidence_quote: reversed the SNI-induced overexpression of Piezo1 in the bilateral ACC (Figure 7C) and alleviated SNI-induced allodynia

key_findings: SNI increased Piezo1 in ACC parvalbumin interneurons, reduced PV-IN number and vGAT inhibitory terminals, and activated phagocytic (CD68+, amoeboid) microglia encapsulating Piezo1+ neurons.
TNF-α elevated Piezo1 and NLRP3 in BV2 cells and ACC neurons; the NLRP3 inhibitor MCC950 blocked caspase-1/IL-1β induction, reversed SNI-induced ACC Piezo1 overexpression and alleviated allodynia.
